2116908125177676156.en_summary: Annual AI data center capacity additions projected to quadruple to 104GW by 2030: $NVDA GPUs ~50GW, $GOOGL TPUs ~21GW, $AMZN Trainium ~15GW, $AMD GPUs ~9GW. Rack density to more than triple to ~285kW by 2030, shifting to liquid cooling and redesigned power distribution; infrastructure readiness a major gating factor. Related: $CLS high-density racks, $VRT liquid cooling, $GEV high-voltage gear, $FPS switchgear, $ON silicon carbide, $NVTS GaN/SiC.
